issues.description: The problem statement and solution use the function name simulate_msd_one_round(...) for simulating one round of MSD, but the template repository defines a stub named simulate_one_round(...). This cross-artifact name mismatch (simulate_one_round vs simulate_msd_one_round) breaks the conceptual mapping: students reading the problem will implement/expect simulate_msd_one_round, but the starter code exposes simulate_one_round and the template's plot_msd even calls simulate_msd_one_round (which doesn't exist in the template). This will cause confusion and likely runtime/name errors or failing tests, and forces students to reconcile two different names for the same core functionality.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the function name consistent across all artifacts. Rename the template stub simulate_one_round(...) to simulate_msd_one_round(...) (matching the problem statement and solution). Also ensure plot_msd in the template calls the same name; alternatively, update the problem statement and solution to use simulate_one_round if that is preferred. Prefer keeping simulate_msd_one_round for clarity.
